text_a: Ana envió el contrato ayer por la tarde.
text_b: Ayer por la tarde Ana mandó el contrato.

text_a: The billing team has sent the invoices.
text_b: The billing team sends the invoices.
what_differs: A states a completed event; B states a habitual responsibility with no claim that it happened.

text_a: O sistema enviará o lembrete amanhã às 8h.
text_b: Amanhã às 8h, o lembrete será enviado pelo sistema.

text_a: The server sends an alert when disk usage exceeds 90%.
text_b: The server will send an alert when disk usage exceeds 90%.
what_differs: Present may describe current behavior while future may describe a planned change; or both may be generic rules.

text_a: Revisa cada archivo antes de subirlo.
text_b: Revisa todos los archivos antes de subirlos.
what_differs: A is per-file review then upload; B may mean review the whole set before uploading any.

text_a: Delete the attachment from the ticket.
text_b: Delete the attachments from the ticket.
what_differs: One specific attachment versus all attachments.

text_a: Cada usuário pode baixar o arquivo.
text_b: Todos os usuários podem baixar os arquivos.
what_differs: A refers to a single file; B to multiple files.

text_a: Please sign every page of the contract.
text_b: Por favor, firma todas las páginas del contrato.

text_a: One in ten requests is sampled for review.
text_b: 10% of requests are sampled for review.

text_a: La mitad del presupuesto se destina a marketing.
text_b: El 50 % del presupuesto va a marketing.

text_a: Reembolsamos 10% do valor da compra.
text_b: Reembolsamos 10 reais do valor da compra.
what_differs: Relative percentage versus a fixed absolute amount.

text_a: About a third of the tickets were escalated.
text_b: 30% of the tickets were escalated.
what_differs: Approximate one third (~33%) versus a precise 30%; readers may or may not treat them as the same.

text_a: Solo los administradores pueden borrar canales.
text_b: Los administradores pueden borrar canales.
what_differs: A makes admins exclusive; B grants admins the right without excluding others.

text_a: Everyone except guests can edit the board.
text_b: All members can edit the board.
what_differs: Same only if every non-guest is a member; other roles (e.g. external viewers) may exist.

text_a: Qualquer membro da equipe pode aprovar a despesa.
text_b: A despesa pode ser aprovada por qualquer integrante da equipe.

text_a: Cualquier persona con el enlace puede ver el documento.
text_b: Cualquier persona de la organización puede ver el documento.
what_differs: Access by link (possibly external) versus access limited to organization members.

text_a: Deleted items are moved to the trash for 30 days.
text_b: When you delete an item, it goes to the trash and stays there for 30 days.

text_a: Esta acción no se puede deshacer.
text_b: Esta acción es irreversible.

text_a: Mova os registros antigos para a lixeira.
text_b: Exclua permanentemente os registros antigos.
what_differs: Trash is recoverable; permanent deletion is not.

text_a: Cerrar la cuenta es definitivo.
text_b: El usuario no puede revertir el cierre de la cuenta.
what_differs: B only rules out reversal by the user; support might still reverse it, while A suggests nobody can.

text_a: La actualización debería estar lista el viernes.
text_b: La actualización estará lista el viernes.
what_differs: Hedged expectation versus a firm commitment.

text_a: The migration is expected to finish by noon.
text_b: The migration should finish by noon.
what_differs: 'Should' can be read as expectation (same) or as a requirement/deadline (different).

text_a: A entrega provavelmente vai atrasar.
text_b: A entrega pode atrasar.
what_differs: Probable delay versus merely possible delay.

text_a: Delivery is guaranteed within 48 hours.
text_b: We guarantee delivery within 48 hours.

text_a: Según el registro, el pago falló a las 3:12.
text_b: El registro indica que el pago falló a las 3:12.

text_a: The vendor confirmed the outage is resolved.
text_b: The vendor reportedly resolved the outage.
what_differs: Direct confirmation by the vendor versus secondhand, unverified report.

text_a: Segundo o contrato, a multa é de 2%.
text_b: Conforme estabelecido no contrato, a multa é de 2%.

text_a: Supuestamente el cliente canceló el pedido.
text_b: Parece que el cliente canceló el pedido.
what_differs: 'Supuestamente' implies a third-party claim; 'parece' implies the speaker's own inference; both are uncertain.

text_a: Retry the upload once more if it fails.
text_b: If the upload fails, retry it again.
what_differs: A caps retries at one; B does not state how many retries are allowed.

text_a: Envía el recordatorio dos veces.
text_b: Envía el recordatorio otra vez.
what_differs: Two sends in total versus one additional send (count depends on prior sends).

text_a: Peça a senha toda vez que o usuário abrir o app.
text_b: Peça a senha sempre que o usuário abrir o app.

text_a: The alert fires each time the threshold is crossed.
text_b: The alert fires whenever the value is above the threshold.
what_differs: Edge-triggered once per crossing versus firing continuously while above the threshold.

text_a: The report is due at noon UTC.
text_b: The report is due at 12:00 UTC.

text_a: La reunión es a las 9:00, hora de Bogotá.
text_b: La reunión es a las 14:00 UTC.

text_a: O suporte atende das 9h às 18h, horário local.
text_b: O suporte atende das 9h às 18h UTC.
what_differs: Local time versus UTC; same digits, different actual hours for most users.

text_a: Submit it by the end of the business day.
text_b: Entrégalo antes de que termine el día.
what_differs: End of business hours (e.g. ~17:00) versus end of the calendar day (midnight).

text_a: Tu suscripción quedará suspendida.
text_b: Tu suscripción quedará cancelada.
what_differs: Suspension is temporary and resumable; cancellation ends the subscription.

text_a: We will issue a credit to your account.
text_b: We will refund the charge to your card.
what_differs: Store/account credit versus money returned to the payment method.

text_a: O gerente aprovou a solicitação.
text_b: O gerente deu o aval à solicitação.

text_a: Please acknowledge the policy update.
text_b: Please confirm that you have received the policy update.
